steps.text: Each Rival: a color, cubes on each Influence track, {n} troops in its garrison, 2 Agents, 3 Spies and 1 water; Swordmaster beside the board
Shuffle the House Hagal deck near the Rivals
Solo: remove the Reshuffle card (marked 2P) first
Remove Uprising's Accept Contract/Shipping (2), Gather Support (2) and Assembly Hall; add Rise of Ix's Hagal cards for your count except Foldspace/Interstellar Shipping
Solo: remove 1 Uprising Research Station card and add all 4 Immortality Hagal cards
Give the Rival the Ornithopter Objective; deal the other two randomly
You and your Rivals each get a random Objective
You start with an Intrigue card
Use Brutal Escalation, Expert Deployment and Smart Politics
You can't gain a Swordmaster this game
The game ends after the round in which someone reaches {n} VP (or the Conflict deck runs out)
You can't send an Agent without a card that allows that space
Rivals take Agent turns only, never Reveal turns
The Rival always acts between the two players and never holds the First Player marker
Streamlined: Lady Amber and the Beast can't win; after their Swordmaster, their bonus spice goes to the bank
Commanders activate one Ally each turn for troops, Influence and swords
Whoever's Objective shows the First Player marker takes it
Reveal the top Conflict card; everyone draws {n} cards
